The total cost of the four pizzas is $64. Two of the pizzas cost $30 together. To find the cost of the other two pizzas, we subtract the cost of the two known pizzas from the total:

$$
64 - 30 = 34
$$

Since the other two pizzas cost the same amount, we divide the remaining cost by 2:

$$
34 \div 2 = 17
$$

FINAL_ANSWER: 17
